data.one_liner: Extension of webview_flutter to load local HTML, CSS, and JS from assets or strings via a local server.
data.what_it_does: Extends webview_flutter to facilitate loading local HTML, CSS, and JavaScript content from assets or strings through a local server. It also provides a way to get the WebViewWidget height for rendering inside lists.
use_when: You need to load local HTML, CSS, or JavaScript files from assets.
You want to render HTML strings inside a Flutter application via a web view.
You need features built on top of webview_flutter with local server support.
avoid_when: You only need standard remote URL web views and can use the base webview_flutter directly.
You do not want to configure platform-specific cleartext traffic or arbitrary loads settings.
strengths: Loads local assets including HTML, CSS, and JavaScript easily.
Inherits features from the stable webview_flutter package.
Provides helper to retrieve web view height for list views.
weaknesses: Requires manual Android and iOS manifest/plist configuration for cleartext traffic and arbitrary loads.
Depends on an internal local server implementation which might introduce edge cases.
data.setup_notes: Requires adding android:usesCleartextTraffic='true' and INTERNET permission in AndroidManifest.xml, and NSAppTransportSecurity with NSAllowsArbitraryLoads in iOS Info.plist.

alternatives.name: webview_flutter
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you only need official remote web views without the local asset server extension and extra platform configurations.
